description.value: The Walter C. Koerner Library is a five-storey academic library at the heart of the UBC Vancouver campus, housing major humanities and social sciences collections. It is publicly accessible and sits within UBC's expansive campus grounds, which are popular with cyclists connecting to the Pacific Spirit Regional Park trail network. Touring cyclists passing through the Point Grey area will find it a convenient landmark stop on campus.
